challenge: Creating abstract compositions that embrace the relaxed, decorative spirit of bohemian aesthetics while maintaining compositional rigor. The series needed to feel approachable and lived-in, with repeated motifs and layered color fields that invite extended viewing rather than demanding attention.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to establish motif rhythm and palette across a series of warm, layered compositions. In-painting refined edges and micro-contrast relationships, while Lightroom handled color depth and spatial pacing to ensure each panel feels both casual and considered.
result: Produced a six-piece bohemian abstraction series with cohesive, approachable compositions that read clearly in tile grids and hold stacked color detail at full resolution. The collection works well for art prints, interior decor applications, and portfolio display.
